name: @vindicate/runtime-mcp
description: Vindicate MCP server — browser automation, orchestration, and project file tools

scripts.build: pnpm run validate-content && pnpm --filter @vindicate/vindicate-ui run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run copy-content
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @vindicate/protocol run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.build:bundle: pnpm --filter @vindicate/protocol --filter @vindicate/observability --filter @vindicate/vindicate-ui run build && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module';import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';import { dirname } from 'node:path';const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);const __dirname = dirname(__filename);" --outfile=dist/bundle.mjs && pnpm run copy-content
